PreToolUse.command: bash -c 'read cmd; for banned in "git add -u" "git add -A" "git add ." "git commit -a"; do if echo "$cmd" | grep -qF "$banned"; then echo "[HOOK BLOCKED] 禁止无差别暂存命令: $banned"; echo "请使用 git add <specific-file> 逐个精确暂存"; exit 1; fi; done; exit 0'
PreToolUse.description: 阻止 git add -u/-A/. 和 git commit -a — 强制逐个文件暂存
